description: Normative wiring coverage. Every shipped multi-session skill must declare a visibility section whose table contains one LOOPVIZ marker per required entry point. The PowerShell validator enforces this file against the skills, so adding a skill or an entry point fails validation until the wiring exists.
absenceRule: Probe once at the run-declaration entry point. If the reporter tools are absent, record reporter-absent once, omit every remaining visibility call for the run, and never retry a missing tool.

duplicationGuard.description: Invariant text lives only in the shared contract. A skill that restates these normative rules instead of referencing the shared contract fails validation.

futureSkillRule.description: Discovery is by directory, not by an allow list. Every skills/<name>/SKILL.md whose front matter description mentions coordinating child or multi-session work must appear in skills{} above with a full entry-point set.
